Interface Ports

All Known Implementing Classes:
PortsImpl
public interface Ports
Client interface for managing Equinix Fabric ports. Provides operations for listing, retrieving, and monitoring port bandwidth statistics.
Author:
ianjones

    • getStatistics

      @Deprecated PortStatistic getStatistics(String uuid, LocalDateTime startDateTime, LocalDateTime endDateTime)
      Deprecated.
      the /stats endpoint is deprecated by Equinix; use getMetrics(String, String, LocalDateTime, LocalDateTime) or Metrics.search(FilterPropertyList) instead.
      Retrieves bandwidth statistics for a port over the specified time range.

      UTC contract: LocalDateTime inputs are UTC wall clock (matching every timestamp the SDK returns); use LocalDateTime.now(ZoneOffset.UTC) for the current time.

      Parameters:
      uuid - the unique identifier of the port
      startDateTime - the start of the statistics time range, as UTC wall clock
      endDateTime - the end of the statistics time range, as UTC wall clock
      Returns:
      the port statistics for the specified time range

    • getMetrics

      List<Metric> getMetrics(String uuid, String name, LocalDateTime fromDateTime, LocalDateTime toDateTime)
      Retrieves metrics for a single port over the specified time range. This is the non-deprecated replacement for getStatistics(String, LocalDateTime, LocalDateTime).

      UTC contract: LocalDateTime inputs are UTC wall clock (matching every timestamp the SDK returns); use LocalDateTime.now(ZoneOffset.UTC) for the current time.

      Parameters:
      uuid - the unique identifier of the port
      name - the metric name to retrieve (for example equinix.fabric.port.bandwidth_rx.usage), or null for all metrics
      fromDateTime - the start of the metrics time range, as UTC wall clock
      toDateTime - the end of the metrics time range, as UTC wall clock
      Returns:
      the list of metrics for the port over the specified time range

    • delete

      Port delete(String uuid, boolean dryRun)
      Deletes a port by its unique identifier, optionally as a validate-only dry run (DELETE /fabric/v4/ports/{uuid}?dryRun=true; spec: "option to verify that API calls will succeed"; boolean, default false).

      With dryRun = true nothing is deleted: the API responds 200 (rather than the real delete's 202 Accepted) with the existing port entity — uuid, name and all — that WOULD be deleted. With dryRun = false this behaves exactly like delete(String).

      Parameters:
      uuid - the unique identifier of the port to delete
      dryRun - true to only verify that the delete would succeed, without deleting
      Returns:
      the deleted port — or, on a dry run, the port that would be deleted
